title: Dermatology Appointment Copay Leaderboard
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=derm:appointment copay_usd=*
| stats sum(copay_usd) as total_value, avg(copay_usd) as avg_value by provider_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks provider values by total and average copay across dermatology appointment events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `copay_usd` values for each dermatology appointment event and review total and average copay by provider.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total copay.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which provider shows the biggest copay numbers in your dermatology appointment data.
